title: BENCHMARKS FOR ORGANIC PRODUCTS OF NCOL
body_text:
National Cooperative Organics Limited (NCOL) markets its certified organic products under the "Bharat Organics" brand through a multi-channel marketing strategy. Its products are marketed via various e-commerce platforms, modern retail chains, cooperative outlets including Safal/Mother Dairy, NAFED, NCCF, etc., and its Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) portal.
The benchmark for organic production in India is the National Programme for Organic Production (NPOP), which is notified by the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA). National Cooperative Organics Limited (NCOL) complies with these benchmarks by procuring and marketing only certified organic products that conform to NPOP standards. The products are sourced from valid certified farmer groups, Internal Control Systems (ICS), or certified operators and are subject to stringent quality testing, traceability mechanisms, and compliance with applicable food safety and organic certification requirements. In addition, NCOL ensures mandatory laboratory testing of organic produce for pesticide residues and other quality parameters before marketing, thereby maintaining the prescribed standards for organic production in India.
NCOL promotes the formation of National Programme for Organic Production (NPOP)-certified Internal Control System (ICS) groups through cooperative societies to support organic farmers. It facilitates the procurement of certified organic produce through cooperative societies at fair and transparent prices and markets organic products under the Bharat Organics brand through multiple sales channels. NCOL has signed Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with 28 States/UTs to promote the organic cooperative ecosystem and facilitate greater participation of farmers in organic farming.
This information was given by Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation, Shri Amit Shah in a written reply in Rajya Sabha.

enrichment.summary: National Cooperative Organics Limited (NCOL) markets certified organic products under the 'Bharat Organics' brand through e-commerce, modern retail, cooperative outlets (Safal/Mother Dairy, NAFED, NCCF) and a D2C portal. It complies with National Programme for Organic Production (NPOP) standards notified by APEDA, sourcing from certified farmer groups/ICS, conducting mandatory lab testing for pesticide residues, and has signed MoUs with 28 States/UTs to promote organic cooperative farming. This was stated by Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah in a written reply in Rajya Sabha.
enrichment.context:
NCOL was registered in 2023 under the Ministry of Cooperation as part of a broader push to strengthen cooperative-based value chains, alongside similar entities like the National Cooperative Exports Limited and Bharatiya Beej Sahakari Samiti. It aims to create an integrated national market for organic produce by aggregating output from small and marginal farmers organized into cooperatives and Internal Control System (ICS) groups, thereby reducing dependence on fragmented, unorganized organic markets and giving farmers better price realization. The NPOP, administered by APEDA under the Ministry of Commerce, is India's official organic certification standard and is also the basis for export certification, aligning domestic organic production with international norms.

This initiative fits into the government's broader cooperative sector reform agenda, including the creation of a separate Ministry of Cooperation in 2021, the 'Sahakar se Samriddhi' vision, and efforts to revitalize PACS (Primary Agricultural Credit Societies) into multi-service centers. Organic farming promotion also intersects with schemes like Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) and Mission Organic Value Chain Development, and supports natural farming goals aimed at soil health, farmer income enhancement, and sustainable agriculture under India's climate commitments.

Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)
Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
